construction: Rough manual interpretation of the retained legal boundary sequences against retained OSM streets, rail and river lines. Parcel, forest-strip and natural-slope continuations use straight approximate joins. Coordinates are selected geographic anchors, not measured legal corners. Overlap is intentional and no cadastral accuracy is claimed.

units.name: Hets-telep
units.uncertainSegments: Northern parcel/built-up boundary and natural slope following the Táncsics continuation are approximated; western side follows the general river-side corridor.

units.name: Sólyom-telep
units.uncertainSegments: Current Csendes, Sínpár and Grassalkovich road lines no longer meet in the sequence stated by the legal source; long intervening portions are explicitly estimated connectors.

units.name: Történeti központ
units.uncertainSegments: Several former street connections, Tárcsás continuation to the river and northern natural-slope segment are estimated. The ring is a broad search footprint, not a claim that every vertex lies on the named source boundary.

units.name: Vargatelep
units.uncertainSegments: Véderdő forest-strip and rail/street continuity approximated from legal sequence. Straight road-end joins retained; approximate footprint can overlap neighboring names.
